tips.text: Stockpile the build resources before the event starts so you can build the same day.
Bring Nova, Loki, Wisp and Mirage to speed the drone run; coordinated squads finish in 6 to 8 minutes.
Bring 4 Phylaxis and 4 Catalysts for about 3,000 Standing a run instead of about 1,000.
Run the basic tier if you are solo and under-geared; Advanced and Steel Path Hemocytes resist status and attenuate damage.
Open and close the Nightwave menu to skip the long dialogue pause between stages.
Use an Archwing Launcher to cross the Plains between phases.
Expect no farming complaints; the only regret players report is missing the event window.
